text_block_list.text:
Soon after her debut, Эйр Грув finds
herself
juggling her work with the
student council,
guiding the academy's
younger students, and of
course,
pursuing her own ideal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Choosing to trust in her fully, I decide
the most
suitable upcoming race for the
Empress is the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As Эйр Грув wishes to enter the race
as well,
our next goal is unanimous—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To make Эйр Грув the queen of the
junior year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
